text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian wins the Arima Kinen in a magnificent showing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clearly frustrated, Hishi Amazon vows to challenge her again. Narita Brian looks forward to their rematches, knowing Amazon will never give up,

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've crossed paths with quite a few strong racers over the past year, and racing against them has given Narita Brian great satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The new year brings the start of her senior year, and our next goal—the Hanshin Daishoten!
